title: The Pot of Tomato Soup
youtube_title: The Pot of Tomato Soup | Bedtime Story for Kids in English
moral: Making room at the table is a kind of abundance.
summary: At a ferry bench with a folded blanket, Yelena sees that a pot of tomato soup with a second bowl nearby will not feel fair if only one person is served first. Yelena makes a smaller, even share so Zia is included, and Miss Dalca lets the choice stand without a speech.
